name: Nathaniel Tomford
description: Son of Mike Tomford, a longtime CFC figure. One of JD's early CFA friends and a regular golf companion on the Madrid course in the mid-2010s.
public_footprint:
From Gouverneur, NY; studied Legal Studies at SUNY Canton, earning President's List honors repeatedly (2020-2023) plus earlier Dean's List honors.
Sources: https://canton.meritpages.com/stories/Nathaniel-Tomford-Earns-President-s-List-Honors-at-SUNY-Canton-/31758398; https://meritpages.com/Nathaniel-Tomford/5737223
